import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXB = (1 << 19) | 5;
    static final int LAYERS = 20;
    
    static int n, k, p;
    static int lim;
    static int[] bits = new int[MAXB];
    static int[] fvec = new int[MAXB];
    static int[][] bucketA = new int[LAYERS][MAXB];
    static int[][] bucketB = new int[LAYERS][MAXB];
    static int[][] bucketC = new int[LAYERS][MAXB];
    static long pp;
    static long[][] tempArr = new long[LAYERS][MAXB];
    static long[] fact = new long[MAXB];
    static long[] invfact = new long[MAXB];
    static int[][] store = new int[LAYERS][MAXB];
    static long[] fwtTmp = new long[MAXB];
    
    static long binpow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) res = res * base % p;
            base = base * base % p;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static void precomputeFactorials() {
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= lim; i++) fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p;
        invfact[lim] = binpow(fact[lim], p - 2);
        for (int i = lim - 1; i >= 0; i--) invfact[i] = invfact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p;
    }
    
    static int getPowerBound(int x) {
        int v = 1;
        while (v < x) v <<= 1;
        return v;
    }
    
    static void fwtTransform(int[] vec, int len, boolean invert) {
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) fwtTmp[i] = vec[i];
        if (invert) {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += (step << 1)) {
                    for (int j = i; j < i + step; j++) {
                        fwtTmp[j + step] -= fwtTmp[j];
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int step = 1; step < len; step <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < len; i += (step << 1)) {
                    for (int j = i; j < i + step; j++) {
                        fwtTmp[j + step] += fwtTmp[j];
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            vec[i] = (int)(fwtTmp[i] % p);
            if (vec[i] < 0) vec[i] += p;
        }
    }
    
    static void safeAdd(long[] arr, int idx, long val) {
        arr[idx] += val;
        if (arr[idx] >= pp) arr[idx] -= pp;
    }
    
    static void combine(boolean self) {
        if (self) {
            for (int i = 0; i < LAYERS; i++) Arrays.fill(tempArr[i], 0, lim + 1, 0L);
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) {
                for (int b = 0; a + b < LAYERS; b++) {
                    for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) {
                        safeAdd(tempArr[a + b], i, (long)bucketB[a][i] * bucketB[b][i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) store[a][i] = (int)(tempArr[a][i] % p);
            }
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) fwtTransform(store[a], lim + 1, true);
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) Arrays.fill(bucketB[a], 0, lim + 1, 0);
            for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) bucketB[bits[i]][i] = store[bits[i]][i];
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) fwtTransform(bucketB[a], lim + 1, false);
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < LAYERS; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(bucketA[i], 0, lim + 1, 0);
                Arrays.fill(tempArr[i], 0, lim + 1, 0L);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) bucketA[bits[i]][i] = fvec[i];
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) fwtTransform(bucketA[a], lim + 1, false);
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) {
                for (int b = 0; a + b < LAYERS; b++) {
                    for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) {
                        safeAdd(tempArr[a + b], i, (long)bucketA[a][i] * bucketB[b][i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) bucketC[a][i] = (int)(tempArr[a][i] % p);
            }
            for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) fwtTransform(bucketC[a], lim + 1, true);
            for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) fvec[i] = bucketC[bits[i]][i];
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        p = sc.nextInt();
        pp = (long)p * p;
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(binpow(k, n));
            return;
        }
        fvec[0] = 1;
        lim = getPowerBound(n + 1) - 1;
        precomputeFactorials();
        for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) bits[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) bucketB[bits[i]][i] = (int)invfact[i];
        for (int a = 0; a < LAYERS; a++) fwtTransform(bucketB[a], lim + 1, false);
        int orig = k;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) combine(false);
            k >>= 1;
            if (k > 0) combine(true);
        }
        long ans = (binpow(orig, n) - fact[n] * fvec[n] % p + p) % p;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
